scope: T11/T12: native scheduler and process-provider result ownership, correlation and cancellation

raw_evidence.availability: Local execution artifacts; raw logs are not distributed in Git. The manifest records their hashes and exact argv.

checks.ignored_reason: The child_waits_for_input_eof libtest fixture is launched by the parent process-ownership test; it is not run as a standalone test.

T11: Native Invoke/Await/Resume scheduling, recursive operation dispatch and explicit grants.
Accepted child partials and Reports survive validation/allocation stops before the Resume callback begins.
Initially checked terminal replies remain inspectable when result acceptance or root lifetime completion stops.
T12: Process framing, schema exchange, native/process fixture comparisons, cancellation and blocked-read deadlines.
Active/managed reply routing preserves checked replies and their original request/source-grant context if lifetime correlation fails.
Unauthorized diagnostic sources are rejected before a reply becomes inspectable as checked.

review.scope: Provider ownership and source-authority changes at source_revision; transport 30 tests independently passed. The submitting PR records the review summary.
not_reexecuted: The independent provider reviewer did not rerun WASI or OS process tests.

excluded_acceptance_portions: This slice does not decide P02, E06, G05, W02, W03 or any other formal acceptance group.
Full suite Profile, standard-language bridges, Math output-policy integration and general provider routing remain incomplete.
Source-level import, dynamic package loading, distributed provenance and cross-process cumulative resource enforcement remain outside this slice.
Native process comparisons use small fixture operations; Doc/Circuit independent distribution is not established by them.
Deep terminal-result validation reuse and Sentence/Doc ownership migration remain open.
